title: Water Between Walls
commonMistakes: Moving the taller wall, which cannot increase the height and always loses width
Using a nested loop when the input can contain 100,000 walls
Assuming the tallest two walls always form the best tank
followUps: Can you prove that moving the shorter wall never skips the best pair?
What changes if each wall also has a thickness?
How would you answer many queries over the same heights?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
